title: fix(spec,service-settings): name the hosted product "ObjectOS Cloud" in the AI 501 remedy, settings hints, docs and READMEs
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9HSbaezN5sJxczqPerA1G27)_
Fixes #26228
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

The residue of the ObjectOS product-name ruling (model 2: ObjectOS is the product, in Community / Cloud / Enterprise editions; ObjectStack is the protocol, SDK, CLI and framework). Every remaining user-read "ObjectStack Cloud" now reads "ObjectOS Cloud". Where a sentence means the hosted control plane as a system, the same sentence says "the ObjectOS Cloud control plane".

Five commits:

1. **The AI 501 remedy, with all its pins, in one commit.** `REMEDY_DETAIL['ai']` in `packages/spec/src/system/core-services.zod.ts` now reads "Provided by @objectstack/service-ai in ObjectOS Cloud/Enterprise — no implementation ships in the open framework". This is the message every `/ai/*` 501 body carries and the one `/discovery` reports as `services.ai.message`. Moving with it: the exact-string pin in `packages/runtime/src/domains/ai-anonymous-deny-ordering.test.ts`; the two `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ai.json` clauses, with revisions bumped (open-edition-honest-degradation 1 to 2, console-ai-surface-gating 6 to 7) and history rows appended; the `http-protocol.mdx` discovery example; and the `services-checklist.mdx` quotation.
2. **Settings hints.** `service-settings` `ai.manifest.ts` ("realized only by an ObjectOS Cloud tier") and `knowledge.manifest.ts` (the turso "Test connection" hint, "built in the ObjectOS Cloud monorepo"), plus the `knowledge.manifest.test.ts` property pin.
3. **Docs and READMEs.** `content/docs/deployment/{cloud-connection,index,publish-and-preview}.mdx`, `protocol/objectql/schema.mdx`, `protocol/kernel/metadata-service.mdx`, `ui/setup-app.mdx`, `ROADMAP.md`, and the READMEs of `adapters/hono`, `drivers/driver-memory`, `services/service-package` and `services/service-cluster-redis`.
4. **Developer comments only.** `packages/cli/src/**` and `packages/cli/test/**` headers and measurement notes, `packages/cloud-connection/src/{marketplace-proxy-plugin,marketplace-public-url,runtime-config-plugin}.ts`, and `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts`. Four lines were re-wrapped where the longer "the ObjectOS Cloud control plane" pushed them past their paragraph's width.
5. **Changeset** `.changeset/26228-objectos-cloud-residue.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/runtime` and `@objectstack/service-settings`.

Unchanged: identifiers, env vars (`OS_CLOUD_*`), paths (`~/.objectstack/cloud.json`) and `os cloud …` commands; every `CHANGELOG.md`; `content/docs/releases/**`; `.changeset/26136-objectos-cloud-naming.md`; and every `ui/` path.

## Acceptance

Ran the card's grep, with `.changeset/26136-objectos-cloud-naming.md` also excluded as history:

`git grep -n "ObjectStack Cloud" -- ':!**/CHANGELOG.md' ':!content/docs/releases/**' ':!ui/AGENTS.md' ':!ui/docs/adr/**' ':!.changeset/26136-objectos-cloud-naming.md'`

- **Before**, at `origin/main` `61ba04f6`: 52 lines.
- **After**, at head `40119430`: 3 lines, each kept on purpose.
  - `CHANGELOG.md:737`, the root changelog. The pathspec `**/CHANGELOG.md` does not match the root file, and this is history, so it is left alone.
  - `packages/cli/test/cloud-product-name.test.ts:48,51`. This guard asserts the retired name appears in no cloud-command help string, so the literal is the thing it checks for. Kept as-is.

Tests and pins, all at head `40119430`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings test`: Test Files 60 passed (60), Tests 1000 passed (1000).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/ai-anonymous-deny-ordering.test.ts`: 13/13.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/system/core-service-provider.test.ts`: 9/9. Its `/Cloud\/Enterprise/` regex still holds.
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`: OK, 16 areas, 329 items.
- **Ablation** of the 501 string. With `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, `core-services.zod.ts` was put back to the old product name (anchor 1 to 0, blob `d9d79d6a` to `f3a93587`). The deny-ordering suite then went red: 1 failed, 12 passed, on "keeps the 501 body string-identical to /discovery's services.ai message". After restoring (blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty) and rebuilding, it was 13/13 again. The dist pre-flight's marker reading does not apply here, for two reasons: the runtime suite aliases `@objectstack/spec` to source, and the spec dist spells the em dash as a `—` escape. The red/green pair is the evidence.
- Gate families: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 121 commands, and all 121 were run locally with exit 0 at `40119430`. `--ran` reconciliation: 121 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, a DERIVED zero.
- Link check: no link target changed, only link text. The card's `check:docs-links` exists as no `package.json` script; link checking is the `check-links.yml` CI job on this PR.

## Acceptance notes

- **"Cloud/Enterprise" spelling.** The card suggested "ObjectOS Cloud / Enterprise", with spaces. I kept the existing slash form, "ObjectOS Cloud/Enterprise", because `core-service-provider.test.ts` pins `/Cloud\/Enterprise/` and that file is outside the claimed file surface. Both spellings name the same two paid editions. Changing the spacing is a one-line follow-up in that test if wanted.
- **Not in this PR.** `ui/AGENTS.md` and `ui/docs/adr/0060-*` still carry the retired name. Both are governed (Tier H) and are out of this card's scope by its own item 5.
